comment: I don't know why everyone is putting her down. The class topics were not as exciting as I expected and it did get a little boring at times, but she was very nice and the tests were easy.
Very easy to understand.  Listen to what she says and you will do wonderfully.  She is one of my two favorite profs at UofR.  Love this woman, she helped me decide what to do with my life!
I'm glad she's leaving so I don't have to tell you--DONT TAKE THIS CLASS OR ANY WITH HER AS A TEACHER--especially if you have interest in the subject, because I GUARANTEE you will lose it

I don't know why you guys don't like Prof Thompson yeah she may be a little hard to take early in the morning but she makes up for whatever air-headedness may come across in class with really helpful input in personal meetings.

One professor that does NOT belong at Richmond.. she is extremely unprofessional, gives unfair grades that do not follow the syllabus, and is not intelligent at alll... this class can be very stressful if you're not one of her "favorites."

Horrible horrible teacher.  Complete ditz.  Don't write anything complicated or she won't understand it and will give you a bad grade.  Doesn't read half the things you hand in.  Should not be a professor.
Great teacher.  Copy down the notes and your going to be fine.  Very personal too and always willing to help.  She listens to anything you have to say in class.

Dr. Thompson is a great teacher; she's enthusiastic, high-spirited and entertaining.  Just do the work and the reading and you'll get an A - you don't have to study all the time or write incredible papers.  Also, the second half of the class is really chill, while other classes get more stressful.

really disappointing.  studied an incredible amount for her test and got a C-, (which was good).  apparently everything she writes on the board is wrong on the test.  do not take her class.  not a competent professor.  should teach middle school.  half the time she confuses herself

Got into trouble for giving too many A's... Since then, her grading seems quite random. Airheaded but very PC. On tests/papers, just regurgitate her notes. Do not write above a fifth grade level- she won't appreciate it. A joke.
